decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir is a low-cost extension of the firm's core hydraulic steel offering, and after a 2024 launch its uncertainty is still unresolved, so keeping this option open costs little.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic push toward digital networking and energy recovery, and its value is still uncertain, so the option is worth holding, although the earlier withdrawal of other digital tools shows it could be pruned.
The overflow flap gate sits close to the established business, already has its own web page signaling commitment, and costs little to maintain, so there is no evidence to justify abandoning it.
